en.title: Florida opens a road trip in Washington with Barkov and Marchand still out
en.deck: Florida has won four of its last five and scored 4.2 goals a game over that stretch, even without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand. Washington has dropped two straight at home, giving up 11 goals, and has had three days off to regroup. The model and the market both see a near coin flip.
news: Barkov and Marchand (both knee) are travelling on Florida's three-game road trip, which starts here, but neither is expected to play. Niko Mikkola left Wednesday's win after taking a shot off the leg, practised Friday and is expected to play.

Florida beat Chicago 5-3 on Wednesday. Sandis Vilmanis had two goals and two assists on a line with Sam Reinhart and Carter Verhaeghe that produced nine points. Florida had not named its goalie; Jacob Markstrom started Wednesday, and Akira Schmid is the other option.
Washington lost 5-1 to Minnesota and 6-5 to Dallas. Logan Thompson was pulled early in the second period against the Stars after allowing four goals on 11 shots, but he is the likely starter again.
The Capitals are without Rasmus Sandin and Vincent Desharnais. Martin Fehervary took a maintenance day Thursday and will play.
records: Florida swept all three meetings last season, including a 5-2 win in Washington in January. This is the first of three meetings this season.
86% of Washington's games have gone over 5.5 goals, and the Capitals allow 3.43 goals a game.
Florida's power play is scoring at 23.9% and its penalty kill is at 84.6%. Washington's penalty kill is at 76.1%.
The model flags Verhaeghe and Jordan Kyrou as finishing above their usual rates, while Alex Ovechkin and Tom Wilson are flagged as due.

sv.deck: Florida har vunnit fyra av de fem senaste och gjort 4,2 mål per match under den perioden, trots att Aleksander Barkov och Brad Marchand saknas. Washington har förlorat två raka hemma och släppt in 11 mål, och har haft tre dagars vila. Både modellen och marknaden ser en ren slantsingling.
news: Barkov och Marchand (båda knä) följer med på Floridas resa med tre bortamatcher, som börjar här, men ingen av dem väntas spela. Niko Mikkola klev av i onsdags efter ett skott mot benet, tränade i fredags och väntas spela.

Florida slog Chicago med 5–3 i onsdags. Sandis Vilmanis gjorde två mål och två assist i en kedja med Sam Reinhart och Carter Verhaeghe som stod för nio poäng. Florida hade inte meddelat målvakt; Jacob Markstrom startade i onsdags och Akira Schmid är det andra alternativet.
Washington förlorade med 5–1 mot Minnesota och 6–5 mot Dallas. Logan Thompson byttes ut tidigt i andra perioden mot Stars efter fyra insläppta mål på 11 skott, men väntas ändå starta.
Capitals saknar Rasmus Sandin och Vincent Desharnais. Martin Fehervary vilade i torsdags och spelar.
records: Florida vann alla tre mötena förra säsongen, bland annat med 5–2 i Washington i januari. Det här är första av tre möten den här säsongen.
86 % av Washingtons matcher har gått över 5,5 mål, och Capitals släpper in 3,43 mål per match.

Modellen flaggar att Verhaeghe och Jordan Kyrou gör mål över sina vanliga nivåer, medan Alex Ovechkin och Tom Wilson ligger under och borde vända uppåt.

en.deck: Nashville has won three straight, the last on Steven Stamkos' overtime goal against Colorado, and has points in six of its last seven. St. Louis closes a four-game road trip after back-to-back losses. The model and the market have it as even as a game gets.
news: Stamkos scored in overtime Thursday as Nashville beat Colorado 3-2. He leads the team with nine goals, five of them in the last seven games.
The Blues lost 5-4 in overtime in New Jersey on Thursday after trailing 4-1. Coach Jim Montgomery said he was happy with the point. Joel Hofer is expected to start; Jordan Binnington played Thursday.
Juuse Saros is the expected starter for Nashville. Jonathan Marchessault is day-to-day. St. Louis is without Torey Krug (out for the season), Dillon Dube, Tyler Tucker and Logan Mailloux.
Nashville won the first meeting 5-2 in Nashville on Oct. 17. This is the second of four.
records: Filip Forsberg has 19 points in 16 games, and Roman Josi leads the team with 16 assists.
Jimmy Snuggerud leads the Blues with eight goals; the model flags him as finishing above his usual rate.
Neither goalie has had much luck in this matchup: Hofer has a .865 save percentage in eight career games against Nashville, Saros .886 in 25 against St. Louis.
Nashville's power play is at 29.6% (5th) and its penalty kill at 90% (3rd). Mavrik Bourque has gone 12 games without a goal.

en.title: Seattle's best-ever start meets the league's top penalty kill
en.deck: Seattle is 9-5-1, the best start in franchise history, but it has only 45% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 and is giving up 3.5 goals a game. The Rangers start a four-game western trip after two straight wins and are 1-5-1 on the road. The model leans slightly to New York, about where the market is.
news: Ty Kartye, picked up on waivers from Seattle late last season, scored the winner with 4:39 left as the Rangers beat Philadelphia 3-2 on Thursday, ending a four-game skid with a second straight win.
Dylan Garand has started all but one game since Igor Shesterkin was hurt on Oct. 9 and is the likely starter again. The Rangers are also without Sean Durzi and Joe Veleno.
Seattle beat Calgary 2-1 on Matty Beniers' overtime breakaway on Wednesday, with Joey Daccord making 25 saves. Daccord is projected to start.
The Kraken traded Shane Wright to Nashville for forward Matthew Wood on Nov. 2. Jared McCann is on injured reserve.
records: Berkly Catton brings a seven-game point streak (three goals, five assists), the longest of his career. The model also flags him and Mackie Samoskevich as running hot.
New York's penalty kill is first in the league at 90.6%. Seattle's is 30th at 65%.
80% of Seattle's games have gone over 5.5 goals, and its PDO of 1.039 suggests some luck behind the results.
Seattle is 5-2-0 at home and won the last meeting, 4-2 in January.

en.title: Tavares set to return as the Leafs host the surging Canadiens
en.deck: Montreal has won six of seven and arrives at 10-3-3 after a comeback overtime win over Utah on Thursday. Toronto is 8-7-2, has lost three of four, and expects John Tavares back after nine games out. The market and the model both see a coin flip.
news: Tavares (lower body) has missed nine games since Oct. 15. He practised Friday in a regular jersey on a line with Nick Paul and William Nylander and is expected to play. He returns to the top power-play unit, pushing Gavin McKenna to the second.
Jacob Fowler is expected in the Montreal net after Jakub Dobes played Thursday. Fowler won the Canadiens' Molson Cup for October.

Nick Suzuki had a goal and two assists Thursday in his return from a six-game absence, and Kirby Dach is also back. Ivan Demidov (fractured ankle) has been out since Oct. 3; GM Kent Hughes says there have been no setbacks but there is no return date.

Toronto lost 3-2 at home to Utah on Tuesday despite 33 saves from Sergei Bobrovsky. Anthony Stolarz is the projected starter. Saturday opens a run of five straight games against teams in a playoff spot.
records: Montreal won the season opener 3-2 at Scotiabank Arena on Sept. 29, spoiling McKenna's NHL debut.
Cole Caufield's overtime winner Thursday was his 15th career OT goal, the fastest anyone has reached that mark (384 games, passing Connor McDavid's 559).
Jack Roslovic carries a career-best seven-game point streak (five goals, seven assists). Tavares has 1,192 career points.
Toronto's power play ranked sixth at 28.8% entering Friday but is 0-for-4 over the last two games. The Leafs have only 45% of the 5v5 expected goals this season.
betting: Market: Canadiens 1.90, Maple Leafs 1.94, about 50–50 without the margin. The model has it 51–49 Canadiens, so the two agree.

Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.54 (about 62%). The model says 55%, cooler than the market. Both teams have gone over 5.5 in about two-thirds of their games, but the last 12 meetings averaged 5.4 goals.
Player chances (model): Suzuki 1+ point 70%, Matthews 1+ point 69% and goal 42% (odds 2.28, about 44% with margin), Caufield goal 41% (odds 2.20, about 45%).

sv.deck: Montreal har vunnit sex av sju och kommer med 10-3-3 efter en vändning och förlängningsseger mot Utah i torsdags. Toronto står på 8-7-2, har förlorat tre av fyra och räknar med att få tillbaka John Tavares efter nio missade matcher. Både marknaden och modellen ser en ren slantsingling.
news: Tavares (underkroppsskada) har missat nio matcher sedan den 15 oktober. Han tränade i vanlig tröja i fredags i en kedja med Nick Paul och William Nylander och väntas spela. Han går in i första powerplayfemman, och Gavin McKenna flyttas till den andra.
Jacob Fowler väntas stå för Montreal sedan Jakub Dobes spelade i torsdags. Fowler fick Canadiens Molson Cup för oktober.

Nick Suzuki gjorde ett mål och två assist i torsdags i comebacken efter sex missade matcher, och Kirby Dach är också tillbaka. Ivan Demidov (fotledsfraktur) har varit borta sedan den 3 oktober; GM Kent Hughes säger att det inte varit några bakslag men att det inte finns något datum för comeback.
Toronto föll med 3-2 hemma mot Utah i tisdags trots 33 räddningar av Sergei Bobrovsky. Anthony Stolarz väntas starta. Lördagens match inleder fem raka mot lag på slutspelsplats.

Cole Caufields avgörande i förlängningen i torsdags var hans 15:e förlängningsmål i karriären, snabbast någonsin till den nivån (384 matcher, före Connor McDavids 559).
Jack Roslovic har en personbästa poängsvit på sju matcher (fem mål, sju assist). Tavares har 1 192 poäng i karriären.
Torontos powerplay var sexa i ligan med 28,8 % inför fredagen men har gått 0 på 4 de två senaste matcherna. Leafs har bara 45 % av de förväntade målen i 5 mot 5 den här säsongen.

en.title: Cooley's hat-trick run meets an Ottawa team still waiting on Ullmark
en.deck: Logan Cooley has scored 10 goals in his last seven games and Utah's power play leads the NHL. Ottawa will again lean on Samuel Ersson, with Linus Ullmark saying he won't play Saturday. Both clubs are 10-6-1, and the model has it even.
news: Ullmark (lower-body strain) has been out since Oct. 21. He practised fully Friday but said he will not play Saturday. He was 7-1-0 with a 1.33 GAA and .945 save percentage before the injury; Ottawa went 3-2-1 without him.
Ersson made 24 saves in Wednesday's 2-1 win in Buffalo, where Michael Amadio scored the winner late in the third. He is 2-3-1 with an .880 save percentage overall but .943 over his last three games.
Ridly Greig (lower body) is doubtful after missing Wednesday's game. William Eklund, Warren Foegele and Andre Burakovsky are out long-term.

Utah lost 5-4 in overtime in Montreal on Thursday, the fourth game of a six-game road trip that ends in Vegas on Wednesday. Coach André Tourigny said he did not like his team's mindset. Sebastian Cossa started the last two games; the site's feed projects Karel Vejmelka.
records: Cooley has hat tricks in two of his last three games and is the fastest active player to five career hat tricks (228 games).
Utah had 20 power-play goals through 16 games, the most in the NHL, and Cooley added two more Thursday.
Mikhail Sergachev has a nine-game point streak (three goals, eight assists), the second-longest in Utah history.
Neither team has won two in a row for a while: Utah none in its last 10 games, Ottawa none in its last 11.

Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.58 (about 60%). The model says 59%, so they agree. Utah has gone over 5.5 in 76% of its games, Ottawa in 47%, and the last six meetings averaged 5.5 goals.

sv.title: Cooleys målrally möter ett Ottawa som fortfarande väntar på Ullmark
sv.deck: Logan Cooley har gjort tio mål på de sju senaste matcherna och Utahs powerplay är bäst i NHL. Ottawa får förlita sig på Samuel Ersson igen sedan Linus Ullmark sagt att han inte spelar på lördag. Båda lagen står på 10-6-1, och modellen ser matchen som helt jämn.
news: Ullmark (sträckning i underkroppen) har varit borta sedan den 21 oktober. Han tränade fullt i fredags men säger själv att han inte spelar på lördag. Han hade 7-1-0, 1,33 insläppta mål per match och 94,5 % räddningar före skadan; Ottawa har gått 3-2-1 utan honom.
Ersson gjorde 24 räddningar i onsdagens 2-1-seger i Buffalo, där Michael Amadio avgjorde sent i tredje perioden. Han har 2-3-1 och 88,0 % räddningar totalt, men 94,3 % de tre senaste matcherna.
Ridly Greig (underkroppsskada) är tveksam efter att ha missat onsdagens match. William Eklund, Warren Foegele och Andre Burakovsky är borta på längre sikt.

Utah förlorade med 5-4 efter förlängning i Montreal i torsdags, den fjärde matchen på en bortaresa med sex matcher som avslutas i Vegas på onsdag. Tränaren André Tourigny var missnöjd med lagets inställning. Sebastian Cossa startade de två senaste matcherna; sajtens data pekar på Karel Vejmelka.
records: Cooley har gjort hattrick i två av de tre senaste matcherna och är snabbast av alla aktiva spelare till fem hattrick i karriären (228 matcher).
Utah hade 20 powerplaymål på 16 matcher, flest i NHL, och Cooley lade till två i torsdags.
Mikhail Sergachev har en poängsvit på nio matcher (tre mål, åtta assist), den näst längsta i Utahs historia.
Inget av lagen har vunnit två raka på länge: Utah inte på de tio senaste matcherna, Ottawa inte på de elva senaste.

en.title: Hellebuyck's perfect Devils start heads to Elmont
en.deck: New Jersey has won three straight and is 4-0-0 with Connor Hellebuyck in goal since getting him from Winnipeg. The Islanders have lost two in a row and have one of the league's quietest offences. The market makes the Devils clear favourites; the model is less sure.

Luke Hughes has a three-game point streak (two goals, two assists), and the model flags him as running hot.
The Islanders scored 2.8 and allowed 4.2 goals a game over their last five. The last 12 meetings averaged 5.75 goals.
